scope: Every discovered registration has one reviewed disposition. This does not assert symbol-level, behavioral, deployment or semantic parity. File catalogs retain additional review candidates rather than declaring every tool a production service.

groups.purpose: Owned execution, validation, replay, causal slicing and the five general CLI commands are shared runtime surfaces.
groups.remainingGate: Exercise all public entries from installed packages with semantic legacy readers absent; do not replace neutral trace APIs with a different format.

groups.purpose: The public training entry still exports the V6 witness, selected harness, model driver and older compiler candidate.
groups.remainingGate: Map every fresh/retained invocation, callback, child, cancellation and restore behavior to V8; switch the public entry only after complete parity.

groups.purpose: The general semantic barrel exposes both V7 and explicit V8 APIs.
groups.remainingGate: Choose one canonical production semantic contract and qualify every exported replacement before retiring older exports.

groups.purpose: The separate semantic/v8 public entry exposes direct V8 source, protocol, training, selected execution and service APIs.
groups.remainingGate: Repeat final-pair source/native/installed proof and complete all lifecycle/host parity; an explicit import does not change defaults.

groups.purpose: The selected Natlang environment imports the V6 harness and selected model driver.
groups.remainingGate: Implement and qualify the corresponding V8 selected environment for fresh and retained calls, result callbacks, errors, identities and durable restart.

groups.purpose: Owned static/evaluated modules, retained module sessions, module facade and non-selected Natlang execution remain public.
groups.remainingGate: Preserve their exact APIs and source behavior; qualify broad V8 source/native projections, live bindings, dynamic imports and persistent recovery before cutover claims.

groups.purpose: Native services, Node/browser capabilities and graph serialization are shared host boundaries.
groups.remainingGate: Run protocol to host to callback to protocol parity for every existing adapter, including cleanup and alias preservation, with legacy selected harness absent.

groups.purpose: The Node storage entry exports trace, module, ingress, selected-service and orchestration persistence.
groups.remainingGate: Bind each store to its owning V8 lifecycle; prove acknowledged recovery, no duplicate external work and explicit unknown outcomes across all supported cuts.

groups.purpose: Virtual bounded agents and real native-worker references are distinct execution profiles.
groups.remainingGate: Retain their scope and identities; do not relabel a virtual scheduler as general agents or shared-memory semantic coverage.

groups.purpose: Default training generation, selected evaluation, recheck, inspection and session campaigns still use legacy semantic tooling.
groups.remainingGate: Provide equivalent original-source V8 generation, split-bound admission, full target exposure, frozen evaluation and fresh release restoration before changing commands.

groups.purpose: The explicitly named V7 admission/export/recheck tools and the default capability ledger retain their recorded version.
groups.remainingGate: Retire active legacy semantic commands after replacement population and final-head proof; preserve historical readers outside installed production dependencies.

groups.purpose: Explicit V8 export/admission/cost/experiment commands and coverage:v8 have an implemented V8 route.
groups.remainingGate: Qualify complete final populations, production tokenizer costs, full optimizer exposure and held-out learned behavior; do not infer those from command availability.

groups.purpose: Contract checking still covers legacy and V8 generated definitions.
groups.remainingGate: Freeze and verify the final paired contract and remove active legacy generation only after replacement parity.

groups.purpose: Corpus acquisition, reference, differential, browser and ordinary test commands retain their complete populations.
groups.remainingGate: Keep failures/refusals/skips visible and preserve non-semantic tools; map any semantic output used for production to the final V8 admission policy.

groups.purpose: Ordinary train/check/evaluate/export/pipeline and distributed coordinator commands share the trainer, with explicit V8 policy and lineage paths.
groups.remainingGate: Qualify real production recipes and assets, resume/stage/distributed lineage, complete scored positions, installed export and service reload on the final pair.

groups.purpose: General codec, data, collection, media, retrieval, serving and infrastructure commands are not all semantic witness routes.
groups.remainingGate: Preserve unrelated formats and model versioning; verify common bundle/asset checks when used by V8 rather than removing whole general commands.

groups.purpose: Python module launchers include CLI, cloud, preparation, publication, cache and worker entrypoints.
groups.remainingGate: Inspect every semantic launch/configuration passed through these entrypoints; qualify source identity, asset isolation and operational restore without assuming module presence is parity.

groups.purpose: The original JSONL selected semantic service still exposes twelve registered operations.
groups.remainingGate: Map all twelve to acknowledged V8 equivalents, including retained requests and closure, then switch callers and retire the old server after end-to-end proof.

groups.purpose: The snapshot V8 server exposes twenty-two registered operation names, including candidate bootstrap and terminal-close recovery.
groups.remainingGate: Qualify complete producer history, exact recovery bytes, every child and terminal cut, unknown-outcome refusals and final installed service; later causal-bootstrap names require a refreshed inventory.

groups.purpose: The default semantic_execution stream still resolves to the older semantic corpus producer.
groups.remainingGate: Make V8 the sole active semantic producer only after original-source supply, recipe and lifecycle parity; explicit V8 selection does not change this default.

groups.purpose: The explicit v8 semantic_execution registry resolves to the strict V8 corpus producer.
groups.remainingGate: Bind final source/registry/tokenizer/contract identities, complete source supply and fresh ordinary preparation; retain every rejection disposition.

groups.purpose: Other registered data streams are unrelated semantic-version contracts and remain part of the general trainer.
groups.remainingGate: Preserve their existing preparation and stage supply; do not remove them as part of a semantic V6/V7 cutover.

groups.purpose: All ten canonical stage definitions are retained in full, including mixture weights and constraints.
groups.remainingGate: Qualify semantic-bearing stages with actual final V8 supply, exact stage-scoped exposure, production assets and cost; keep unrelated mixtures unchanged.
